final: SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS exec_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS exec_fraction FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault WHERE e.fillcount IS NOT NULL AND e.fillcount <> 0 GROUP BY o.orderflow
